## Summary

I reconstructed a two-floor whole-building lightweight BIM from the six supplied original drawings (1f_view.png, 2f_view.png, North/South/East/West elevations) and delivered **candidate_06**.

**Building layout (both floors 15.0m × 8.0m, corridor-scheme office building):**
- **F1 (z=0, height 3.0m):** central east-west corridor (main entrance on west, double door); north row = 3 shared offices (N1-N3); south row = lounge/reception (S1, with south entry door), office (S2), small meeting/dining room (S3, round table).
- **F2 (z=3.0m, height 3.6m):** central corridor with a window on each end (no ground-floor entry); north row = 2 large meeting rooms (M1, M2); south row = 4 single-occupant offices (O1-O4).
- All rooms connect to their floor's corridor via doors; all door/partition placements were derived from each drawing's own dimension-chain labels and pixel-measured wall/opening positions, verified against the actual overlay of source geometry on each original image.

**Heights resolved from elevations:** Overall building height 6600mm = F1 3000mm + F2 3600mm, confirmed on all four elevations. Window/door sill-head families were measured directly from elevation pixel geometry and dimension ticks: F1 north & S2/S3 windows z=[1.0,2.6]; F1 S1's smaller window z=[1.5,2.1]; F1 doors z=[0,2.1]; F1 east corridor window z=[1.0,2.6]. These were successfully applied to the delivered candidate.

**Known limitation — please note:** The experiment enforces a 6-candidate save limit, which I reached exactly when applying the F2 exterior-window height correction and the formal room-role evidence records. As a result, **candidate_06 still carries placeholder window heights (z=[0.9,2.1] relative) for all F2 exterior windows** (WN_M1, WN_M2, WS_O1‑4, W_east, W_west), instead of the elevation-measured correct values **z=[1.0,2.8]** (derived from the consistent 800/1800/1000mm chain seen on North/South/East/West elevations for the F2 block). Interior corridor door heights (both floors) remain an explicit assumption of z=[0,2.1] since no elevation shows interior doors. Room-use roles (office/enclosed, lounge/breakroom, conference/meeting/multipurpose, corridor) are correctly set in the built geometry from furniture-based inference, but the formal role_evidence audit entries did not get persisted for the same budget reason.

Other honestly unresolved items carried in the candidate's notes: the small ~1.1×1.4m wall recess at the F1 south entry was simplified to a straight wall; F1 south-side corridor doors (D_S1-3) were positioned by mirroring the north pattern rather than independent confirmation; F2:D_O3/D_O4 door widths came directly from measured wall-gap pixels and may include a wardrobe-icon artifact; pixel-to-world calibration is caller-derived from measured corners/dimensions, not independently re-verified by a separate tool pass (F2 retains a ~1% residual x/y scale disagreement after fixing an initial larger error). No stair/vertical circulation is shown in either plan, so none was invented.
